text: The van Cittert-Zernike theorem relates the ___ coherence of light from an extended incoherent source to the Fourier transform of the source's intensity distribution.
explanation: The van Cittert-Zernike theorem describes spatial (transverse) coherence, giving a spatial coherence length l_c = λ/θ_s set by the source's angular size. Temporal coherence, by contrast, is governed by the source bandwidth via the Wiener-Khinchin theorem.
